en-e1-l1.title: Ialfabhethi nezwi lokuqala
en-e1-l1.concept: Amagama akhunjulwa kalula uma wazi izwi lokuqala nonhlamvu lokuqala. Khipha izwi bese ufunda kanye nalo.

en-e1-l2.title: Ukubingelela
en-e1-l2.concept: Uma nihlangana, ithi **Hello**, uma nihlukana, ithi **Goodbye**. Igama lakho lisho ngo-**My name is ...**.

en-e1-l3.title: Izinombolo nemibala
en-e1-l3.concept: Funda izinombolo ezinjenge-one, two, three... namagama emibala afana ne-red, blue, yellow...

en-e1-l4.title: Umndeni
en-e1-l4.concept: Amagama okubiza amalungu omndeni afana ne-mother (umama), father (ubaba), grandmother (ugogo), baby (ingane).

en-e1-l5.title: Amagama aseklasini
en-e1-l5.concept: desk, chair, bag, pencil, book... Zama ukusho ngesiNgisi amagama asetshenziswa ekilasini.

en-e2-l1.title: Amagama ezilwane nezinto
en-e2-l1.concept: Amagama anjenge-rabbit (unogwaja), bird (inyoni), fish (inhlanzi) abizwa ngokuthi **amabizo**.

en-e2-l2.title: Amagama achaza ukunyakaza
en-e2-l2.concept: Amagama achaza ukunyakaza afana ne-jump (xhuma), run (gijima), eat (dla) abizwa ngokuthi **izenzo**.

en-e2-l4.title: Ukwakha imisho emifushane
en-e2-l4.concept: Ngemuva kuka-I sebenzisa **am**, ngemuva kuka-You sebenzisa **are**. Umusho ulandela ukuhleleka 'ubani → injani/yenzani'.

en-e2-l5.title: Ukufunda imibhalo emifushane
en-e2-l5.concept: Uma ufunda umbhalo, qala ngokuthola amagama ombuzo embhalweni.

en-e3-abc1.title: Izinhlamvu ezinkulu nezincane zealfabhethi
en-e3-abc1.concept: Ialfabhethi inezinhlamvu **ezinkulu** nezinhlamvu **ezincane**. Amapheya amaningi anezimo ezihlukile, ngakho wakhumbule elilodwa ngelilodwa. Qaphela ikakhulukazi izinhlamvu ezifanayo njenge-b, d, p, q.

en-e3-l1.title: Ukwakha imisho
en-e3-l1.concept: Umusho ulandela ukuhleleka 'ubani → wenzani → ini'. Esenzweni esilandela He, She nenamagama abantu, engeza **-s**.

en-e3-l3.title: Okwamanje nokwedlule
en-e3-l3.concept: Okwamanje noma okuphindaphindwayo kusebenzisa **okwamanje**, okwedlule kusebenzisa **okwedlule** okunezela **-ed** ekugcineni kwesenzo.

en-e3-l4.title: Umsebenzi wansuku zonke
en-e3-l4.concept: get up, brush my teeth, eat breakfast, go to bed... Zama ukusho umsebenzi wakho wansuku zonke ngesiNgisi.

en-e3-l5.title: Ukuqonda umbhalo
en-e3-l5.concept: Funda umbhalo bese uthola ukuthi ubani, nini, nokuthi kwenziwa ini.

en-e3-snd1.title: Ubudlelwano phakathi kwezwi nokubhalwa
en-e3-snd1.concept: Izwi lokuqala nonhlamvu lokuqala legama kuhlobene. Funa amagama aqala ngezwi elifanayo ukuze uzwe ubudlelwano phakathi kwezwi nokubhalwa. Nezinhlamvu ezimbili njenge-ph zingenza izwi elingu-f.

en-e4-l1.title: Okwamanje, okwedlule, ikusasa
en-e4-l1.concept: Okwamanje nokuphindaphindwayo kusebenzisa **okwamanje**, okwedlule kusebenzisa **-ed**, nokuzokwenziwa kusebenzisa **will + isenzo esiyisisekelo**.

en-e4-l2.title: Imibuzo nezinkulumo ezingalungile
en-e4-l2.concept: Umbuzo uqala nge-**Do/Does**, futhi uma uphika, sebenzisa **don't/doesn't**.

en-e4-l3.title: Amagama achaza isimo nomuzwa
en-e4-l3.concept: Ngamagama achaza ukubukeka noma umuzwa njenge-big (enkulu), small (encane), hot (eshisayo), cold (ebandayo).

en-e4-l5.title: Ukufunda imibhalo emifushane
en-e4-l5.concept: Thola embhalweni ukuthi ubani, kuphi, nokuthi kwenziwa ini, bese uphendula.

en-e5-l1.title: Ama-article, isiningi, There is/are
en-e5-l1.concept: Ngaphambi kwezwi elinelungu sebenzisa **an**, ngaphambi kwezwi elingenalo sebenzisa **a**. Uma kukodwa sebenzisa **There is**, uma kuningi sebenzisa **There are**.

en-e5-l2.title: Amagama aqhathanisayo
en-e5-l2.concept: Uma uqhathanisa izinto ezimbili sebenzisa **-er + than**, ku-okukhulu kakhulu sebenzisa **the -est**. Emagameni amade sebenzisa **more**.

en-e5-l3.title: Izinkulumo zekusasa
en-e5-l3.concept: Okuzokwenziwa kusho ngo-**will + isenzo esiyisisekelo** noma **be going to + isenzo esiyisisekelo**.

en-e5-l4.title: Ukubhala kabusha imisho
en-e5-l4.concept: Ezinkulumweni ezingalungile sebenzisa **not / don't / doesn't / didn't**, emibuzweni sebenzisa **Are / Do / Does** ekuqaleni komusho.

en-e5-l5.title: Ukuqonda umbhalo
en-e5-l5.concept: Embhalweni omude, kulula ukufunda uma ukhomba ubani, kuphi, nini, nokuthi kwenziwa ini, sengathi ugcizelela.

en-e6-l1.title: Isifinyezo sazo zonke izikhathi
en-e6-l1.concept: Okwenziwa manje kusho ngo-**be + -ing**, okwedlule ngo-**past form**, nokuzokwenziwa ngo-**will / be going to**.

en-e6-l3.title: Ukwandisa amagama
en-e6-l3.concept: Uma ufunda amagama anencazelo efanayo nalawo aphikisanayo ndawonye, amagama akho aphindeka kabili.

en-e6-l5.title: Ukufunda isigaba
en-e6-l5.concept: Funda umbhalo onemisho eminingi bese uthola ukuthi ubani, nini, kungani kwenziwa, bese uphendula.

en-e6-pun1.title: Izinhlamvu ezinkulu nezimpawu zokuhlukanisa
en-e6-pun1.concept: Umusho uqala ngo-**nhlamvu enkulu** futhi ekugcineni usebenzisa **uphawu lokuhlukanisa** olufanele. Imisho evamile isebenzisa isikhathi (.), imibuzo uphawu lombuzo (?), futhi ukumangala noma umuzwa onamandla uphawu lokumangala (!). Amagama abantu no-I njalo aqala ngonhlamvu olukhulu.

en-e6-seq1.title: Ukuthola ukulandelana kwezehlakalo
en-e6-seq1.concept: Uma uthola amagama akhombisa ukulandelana njenge-**First** (kuqala), **Then / Next** (ngemuva kwalokho), **After that** (ngemuva kwalokho), **Finally** (ekugcineni), ungazi ukulandelana kwezehlakalo.

en-h1-l1.title: Izikhathi eziphelele nezenzo eziqhubekayo eziphelele
en-h1-l1.concept: U-had + p.p. ukhombisa into eyenzeka ngaphambi kwesikhathi esedlule, futhi u-have been -ing ukhombisa isenzo esiqhubeka kuze kube manje.

en-h1-l2.title: Izixhumanisi zokuhlobana nemishwana yamabizo
en-h1-l2.concept: where / when / why ziyizixhumanisi zokuhlobana ezisebenza njengezihlomulisi, futhi whether / that kuqala imishwana yamabizo.

en-h1-l3.title: Participial construction
en-h1-l3.concept: Dilizela isixhumanisi nesihloko, uguqule isenzo sibe yi--ing. Isihloko esiqondiwe kufanele sifane.

en-h1-l4.title: Amagama axhumanisayo nokugeleza kombhalo
en-h1-l4.concept: Hlukanisa isizathu–umphumela (so, therefore), ukuphikisana (however), isibonelo (for example), nokwengeza (in addition).

en-h1-l5.title: Ukuthola umqondo oyinhloko nokuqagela isikhala
en-h1-l5.concept: Umqondo oyinhloko ukokulandela u-However ophikisa umbono ovamile nasemushweni wokugcina. Qagela isikhala ngokugeleza komkhuba → isixazululo → umphumela.

en-h2-l1.title: Ukuguqula ukulandelana nokugcizelela
en-h2-l1.concept: Uma Never/Hardly/Only then iqala umusho, kulandela isenzo sokusiza + isihloko. Gcizelela nge-It is ~ that.

en-h2-l2.title: I-subjunctive mood
en-h2-l2.concept: Emishweni ye-I wish / as if / If, okuphambene nesamanje kusebenzisa isikhathi esedlule, okuphambene nesedlule kusebenzisa had p.p.

en-h2-l3.title: Izixhumanisi zokuhlobana eziyinhlanganisela nemishwana yokuvuma
en-h2-l3.concept: whatever, whoever, whichever, however + isichasiso kusho 'noma yini, noma kunjani'.

en-h2-l4.title: Amagama emongweni
en-h2-l4.concept: Qagela incazelo yamagama angajwayelekile usebenzisa izinkomba zokuphikisana, isibonelo nesizathu, kanye nezandulela.

en-h2-l5.title: Ukuthuthukiswa kwengqondo yombhalo
en-h2-l5.concept: Landela ukugeleza kombhalo ngezinto ezikhonjwa ngamagama akhomba nangamagama axhumanisayo, uqoqe imininingwane ukuze uthole isiphetho.

en-h3-l1.title: Ukwakheka okufanayo nokuvumelana kwenani
en-h3-l1.concept: Imishwana exhunywe nge-and/but/or kufanele ibe nesimo esifanayo, futhi isenzo sivumelane nesihloko esiyinhloko.

en-h3-l2.title: Umoya, ithoni nenhloso
en-h3-l2.concept: Thola umoya ngamagama achaza nawemizwa, nenhloso yombhalo ngokuthi uyacela, uyaqondisa noma uyanxenxa.

en-h3-l3.title: Ukulandelana kwemisho nokufakwa
en-h3-l3.concept: Hlela imisho usebenzisa amagama axhumanisayo, akhomba nokulandelana kwesikhathi njengezinkomba, bese uthola indawo yomusho onikeziwe.

en-h3-l4.title: Ama-collocation nezisho
en-h3-l4.concept: Funda amapheya asetshenziswa ndawonye afana no-make a decision, take a risk, heavy rain, futhi uqagele incazelo yezisho ngesimo.
en-h3-l4.example: the last straw = umkhawulo wokugcina wokubekezela

en-h3-l5.title: Ukuqedela isifinyezo
en-h3-l5.concept: Thola umqondo oyinhloko wombhalo namagama aphikisayo, uwafingqe ube umusho owodwa.

en-h3e-l1.title: Ukukhetha okufanele isimo
en-h3e-l1.concept: Ezinkingeni zengxoxo, ngaphezu kokuthi uhlelo lolimi lulungile yini, kufanele ubheke ukuthi indlela yokukhuluma yemvelo futhi inenhlonipho esimweni. Iziphakamiso, ukuphazamisa, ukuphendula ukudunyiswa, izisho nokukhuluma ngokungaqondile kuvame ukubonakala.

en-h3e-l2.title: Izisho zasemsebenzini nama-collocation
en-h3e-l2.concept: I-English yasemsebenzini igxile ezishweni (touch base), ekufingqweni (njenge-ASAP), namapheya esenzo nesandulela (collocation). Ungaphendli ngokwezwi nezwi; zikhumbule njengamaqoqo asetshenziswa esimweni somsebenzi.

en-h3e-l3.title: Ukufunda ulwazi ngokuhlolisisa
en-h3e-l3.concept: Ku-English yemidiya, kubalulekile ukuhlukanisa amaqiniso nemibono, nokuhlola ukuthi ukuqonda okusetshenziswe embonweni kufanele yini. Khumbula namagama afana nencazelo yesithombe (alt text, caption) noma amathuluzi okuhlela ngenhloso yawo.

en-h3e-l4.title: Amagama ezamasiko nokuvuleka engqondweni
en-h3e-l4.concept: Esihlokweni samasiko omhlaba, funda amagama abalulekile afana ne-culture, diversity ne-stereotype, nezinkulumo zokuqonda amanye amasiko ngaphandle kokuwahlulela. Hlukanisa amagama abukeka efana ngezinkomba zomongo.

en-h3e-l5.title: Ukufunda imisebenzi ngamagama emibhalo
en-h3e-l5.concept: Kuzinkinga zemibhalo, okubalulekile ukwazi incazelo yegama bese uyifaniselisa nesigcawu sendaba. Hlukanisa isexwayiso, uphawu, indlela yokubuka, indikimba nendima yabalingiswa.

en-h3e-l6.title: Ukuhlukanisa izizathu namaphutha
en-h3e-l6.concept: Empikiswaneni udinga ukwazi ukuhlukanisa amagama (motion, rebuttal njalonjalo), izinhlobo zobufakazi namaphutha okuqonda. Uma uhlola isimangalo, qala ngokubuza ukuthi 'ubufakazi balokhu buyini'.

en-h3e-l7.title: Ukubhala okunembile nokufanele inhloso
en-h3e-l7.concept: Ekubhaleni, khetha ifomethi efanele inhloso yombhalo nomfundi, futhi uhlole izingxenye zomusho (isenzi nesihloko) nengqondo yamagama axhumanisayo. Umbhalo othile njengesikhathi sokuphila (resume) ungcono uma unezenzo nezinombolo kunamazwi angacacile.

en-l1.title: Ukufunda amagama asemihlanganweni yansuku zonke
en-l1.concept: Amagama asetshenziswa kaningi akhunjulwa isikhathi eside uma ufunda **umsindo + incazelo + ukubhala** ndawonye. Lalela ukuphinyiswa ngenkinobho yesipikha.
en-l1.example: library = umtapo wezincwadi / desk = ideski / milk = ubisi

en-l2.title: Isenzi se-be: am / are / is
en-l2.concept: Isenzi se-be siguquka ngokuya ngesihloko. **I → am**, **he / she / it → is**, **you / we / they → are**.

en-l3.title: Isenzi esiyisijwayelekile sesikhathi samanje
en-l3.concept: Uma isihloko siyi-**he / she / it (umuntu wesithathu obodwa)**, engeza **-s / -es** esenzweni. Uma siphela nge-ch, -sh, -s, -x, -o sebenzisa -es, futhi uma kuyi-vawuli engeyona + y, shintsha i-y ibe i-i bese ufaka -es!

en-l4.title: Ubuningi nokwakha imisho
en-l4.concept: Uma isibizo siyizinto ezimbili noma ngaphezulu, imvamisa engeza **-s**, uma siphela nge-x engeza **-es**, futhi ubuningi obungajwayelekile bufundwa ngokwahlukana. Umsho ulandela ukuhleleka **isihloko → isenzi → okunye**.

en-m2-l1.title: I-present perfect
en-m2-l1.concept: have/has + past participle. Ikhombisa isipiliyoni, ukuphela noma ukuqhubeka, futhi hlukanisa since (iphuzu esikhathini) ne-for (ubude besikhathi).

en-m2-l2.title: Isenzo esenziwayo (passive)
en-m2-l2.concept: be + past participle kukhombisa 'ukwenziwa'. Owenzayo wengezwa nge-by.

en-m2-l3.title: I-to-infinitive ne-gerund
en-m2-l3.concept: want, hope, decide + to-infinitive; enjoy, finish, avoid + gerund. stop + to V kuyinhloso, stop + V-ing kuwukumisa.

en-m2-l4.title: I-comparative ne-superlative
en-m2-l4.concept: -er/-est ne-more/most. Sebenzisa than ne-comparative, the ne-superlative. good → better → best akujwayelekile.

en-m2-l5.title: Ukufunda: indikimba nemininingwane
en-m2-l5.concept: Funda umbuzo kuqala bese ufuna umusho oyinkomba. Isihloko nenjongo enkulu kuhlanganisa lonke umbhalo.

en-m2-sum1.title: Ukufingqa okuqukethwe umbhalo
en-m2-sum1.concept: Uma ufingqa umbhalo, thola **umongo omkhulu** bese uwunciphisa ube umusho owodwa noma emibili. Umusho okhuluma ngomunye umbandela omncane kuphela, owengeza okungekho embhalweni, noma obanzi kakhulu awuyona ngqo ukufingqa okuhle.

en-m3-l1.title: Izabizwana ezihlobene
en-m3-l1.concept: Hlanganisa imisho emibili ube owodwa nge-who (umuntu), which (into), that (kokubili), whose (ubunikazi).

en-m3-l2.title: Imisho yemibandela ne-past subjunctive
en-m3-l2.concept: If + present, will + V (into engenzeka). If + past, would + V (umcabango ophikisana namanje).

en-m3-l3.title: Imibuzo engaqondile
en-m3-l3.concept: Bhala ngokulandelana kwezabizwana zemibuzo + isihloko + isenzi. Ungasebenzisi do/does/did.

en-m3-l4.title: Izingxenye zesenzo
en-m3-l4.concept: -ing iveza isimo esisebenzayo nesiqhubekayo, -ed iveza isimo sokwenziwa nesiphelile. Ngemizwa, uma kudala umuzwa kusetshenziswa -ing, uma umuntu ezwa kusetshenziswa -ed.

en-m3-l5.title: Ukufunda: ukuqagela nenjongo yombhalo
en-m3-l5.concept: Hlanganisa izinkomba ukuze uqagele, futhi unqume injongo yombhalo ngokubheka isicelo noma umbono.

hints: Kukhona isenzi se-be esisetshenziswa lapho isihloko siyi-I.
Ngemva kuka-I kuza u-am oyisihlobo sakhe.

e-be-2.explanation: Kwabantu abangu-3 ngobuningi obubodwa (She) sisebenzisa u-is: She is my friend.
hints: Yisiphi isenzi se-be esisetshenziswa no-he / she / it?

e-be-3.explanation: U-They ungobuningi, ngakho u-are: They are in the classroom.
hints: Ezihlokweni eziningi (we, you, they) sisebenzisa u-are.

e-be-4.explanation: My brother = he, ngakho u-is: My brother is tall.

e-be-5.explanation: We are ready. kuphela lapho isihloko nesenzi se-be kuvumelana.
hints: Hlola ibhangqa lesihloko nesenzi se-be linye ngalinye.

e-be-v1.explanation: U-You uhlala no-are: You are smart.
hints: U-You ukhethekile. Naphezu kokuba munye, usebenzisa isenzi se-be esifanayo.

e-h3e-conv-4.explanation: Impendulo efanele ithi Let's stop working for now. I-call it a day yisisho esisho ukuthi sinqume umsebenzi wanamuhla lapha. Uma ukhetha ngokubheka amagama athi call, day kuphela ucabanga ngocingo noma usuku, uyaphutha.
hints: Ezishweni, ungazihumushi igama negama, kodwa linganisela incazelo ngesimo sonke.
Cabanga ukuthi yini ehamba kahle ngemva kwemfushane ethi sisebenze amahora ayisithupha.

e-h3e-conv-5.explanation: Impendulo efanele ukucela ukuvala iwindi noma ukwenyusa ukushisa. Kubonakala sengathi kukhuluma ngesimo sezulu, kodwa empeleni kuyisicelo esithambile. Okukhethwa kukho okuchaza isibikezelo sezulu noma okubuza indawo yethemomitha kulandela incazelo yamagama kuphela, ngakho akulungile.
hints: Emshweni okhulunywe ngokungaqondile, cabanga isenzo esifunwa yinkulumi esimeni esinjalo kunencazelo yamagama ngqo.
Bheka ukuthi yisiphi isenzo esixazulula inkinga umhlali ofuna ukuthola kumnikazi wendlu endaweni ebandayo.

e-h3e-conv-d1.explanation: "Your ideas are strong; maybe the ending could be a bit clearer." ithi tactful ngoba iqala ngamandla bese ihlongoza ngezisho ezithambile ezifana ne-maybe, a bit. "Your ending is terrible..." iqinisile kodwa ayinanhlonipho ngoba ilahla omunye ngqo.
hints: I-tactful ukukhuluma ngaphandle kokucasula omunye. Funa umusho oqotho kodwa othambile.
Qhathanisa ukuthi ngabe okukhethwa kukho ngakunye kuyawavuma amandla omngani, nokuthi kusho kanjani okumele kulungiswe.

e-h3e-debate-1.explanation: Impendulo efanele i-Bandwagon appeal. Ukuthi okuthile kulungile ngoba abantu abaningi bakwenza kuyiphutha lomthelela wesixuku. I-Hasty generalization iphutha lokuhlanganisa ngokushesha ngezibonelo ezimbalwa, ngakho ihlukile enhlosweni yalo musho.
hints: Embuzweni wamaphutha, qala ubuze ukuthi isisekelo sesiphakamiso siyisikhonkwane noma okunye.
Qhathanisa iqiniso lokuthi isizathu esithi bonke bayakwenza sisetshenziselwa ukuqinisa isiphakamiso nencazelo yegama ngalinye lephutha.

e-h3e-debate-2.explanation: Impendulo ilungile ithi The park, which opened in May, covers four hectares. Iqukethe amaqiniso aqinisekisekayo kuphela, isikhathi sokuvulwa nendawo. best thing the council has ever done kuyisihlolo, ngakho kuwumbono womuntu.
hints: Ispoint elingenabo ubandlululo liqukethe ulwazi kuphela olungaqinisekiswa yinoma ubani, ngaphandle kwezihlolo noma imizwa.
Emshweni ngamunye, funa amagama abonisa isihlolo noma umuzwa njengokuthi wonderful, fool, best.

e-h3e-debate-3.explanation: Impendulo ilungile ithi motion. Lokhu kubhekisela esitatimendeni esiyisihloko sengxoxo. rebuttal ukuphikisa isimangalo somphikisi, ngakho akuyona isihloko uqobo.
hints: Hlukanisa amagama engxoxo ngomsebenzi wawo engxoxweni.
Qhathanisa okushiwo ‘isitatimende ethimba lombili aphikisana ngaso’ namagama asho ukuphikisa, isinqumo nokurekhoda.

e-h3e-debate-4.explanation: Impendulo ilungile ithi Statistical evidence. Kungoba izinombolo zitholwa ngokuhlola abantu abaningi. Anecdotal evidence wuhlobo lolwazi lomuntu oyedwa noma ababili, ngakho ihlukile kule nhlolovo.
hints: Izinhlobo zobufakazi zihlukaniswa ngomthombo wolwazi. Zikhona amazwi ochwepheshe, ulwazi lomuntu siqu, izinkolelo nezinombolo.
Bheka ukuthi usayizi wesampula (2,000 abantu) nephesenti (64%) kunikeza siphi isiqondiso ngohlobo lobufakazi.

e-h3e-debate-5.explanation: Impendulo ilungile ithi persuasive. Ngemuva kwesenzi be, isikhala sichaza isenzi, ngakho kufika isiphawulo. persuasively liyisandiso, ngakho alikwazi ukuchaza ukuthi speech injani.
hints: Qala ngokunquma uhlobo lwegama lesikhala. Ukulandelana kwamagama ngaphambi nangemuva kudinga luphi uhlobo?
Qinisekisa ukuthi esakhiweni ‘was highly ___’ lesi sikhala sichaza isenzi speech, bese ukhetha uhlobo lwegama oluvumelana naso.

e-h3e-debate-d1.explanation: Isiphakamiso siyenqatshwa ngenxa yezenzo zakudala zikaLena, hhayi okuqukethwe yisiphakamiso, ngakho kuyi-ad hominem (ukuhlasela umuntu). straw man ukuhlasela isimangalo somphikisi esigoqelwe, kodwa lapha isiphakamiso asigoqelwanga.
hints: Embuzweni wephutha lokucabanga, qala ngokubheka ukuthi kugxekwa ini. Uma uqinisekisa ukuthi kuyisimangalo uqobo noma okunye, uhlobo luyancipha.
Bheka ukuthi isikhulumi siphikisana nokuqukethwe isiphakamiso sikaLena se-recycling, noma sisebenzisa elinye iqiniso ngoLena.

e-h3e-job-1.explanation: Impendulo ilungile isho ukuxhumana kafushane ukwabelana ngesimo. touch base kusetshenziswa lapho umuntu exhumana kafushane ukwabelana ngezindaba noma inqubekela phambili. Uma ucabanga ngomdlalo ngenxa yegama base, uzoba nephutha.
hints: Imishwana yasemsebenzini iyadida uma iguqulwa igama negama. Qala ucabange ukuthi isetshenziswa esimeni sini somsebenzi.
Bheka ukuthi osebenza naye uthe ‘ngesonto elilandelayo’, nokuthi isiphakamiso sokwenza ini komunye nomunye engxoxweni yomsebenzi.

e-h3e-job-2.explanation: Impendulo ilungile ithi postponed. Isho ukuhlehlisela isikhathi emuva, ngakho ihambisana ne-until next Monday. finished isho ukuthi umhlangano usuphelile, ngakho ayihambisani ‘nokufika ngoMsombuluko olandelayo’.
hints: Bheka ukuthi isizathu nesikhathi emshweni onesikhala kudala sini.
Qinisekisa ukuthi ushintsho lohlelo luyahambisana nesizathu sokuthi umphathi uyagula nomkhawulo wangoMsombuluko olandelayo.

e-h3e-job-3.explanation: Impendulo ilungile ithi out. run out of kuyisisho esisho ‘ukuphelelwa yinto’. away noma off kungasetshenziswa no-run, kodwa akwenzi lo mqondo olandelwa ngo-of.
hints: Cabanga ukuthi running ngaphambi kwesikhala, of ngemuva, kanye ne-printer paper ngemuva kwe-of kukhombisa isimo sini. Faka amagama amane esikhaleni ngamunye, uzwakalise phezulu ukuthi ‘running ___ of ...’ uzwakala yibhulokhi yemvelo yini.
Ngesizathu esishiwo emshweni wesibili sokuyala iphepha elengeziwe, cabanga ukuthi iphepha lisesimeni sini.

e-h3e-job-4.explanation: Impendulo ilungile ithi at. Sisebenzisa be good at ~ing ukukhuluma ngekhono. good of kusetshenziswa ukudumisa isenzo somuntu njengokuthi ‘ngomusa’, ngakho akuyona inkulumo yekhono.
hints: Hlola ngokuhlangana kwamagama ukuthi isixhumi sini silandela isiphawulo good.
Njengoba kulandela isenzo esiyisibizo esithi solving, funa isixhumi esisetshenziswa ngokukhuluma ngekhono ‘lokuhle ku~’.

e-h3e-job-5.explanation: Impendulo ilungile ithi for your information. Isho ‘ngiyakwazisa ukuze wazi’ futhi isetshenziswa kaningi ku-imeyili. for your invitation isebenzisa F no-Y kahle, kodwa I iba ngubizo, ngakho incazelo iyashintsha.
hints: Ngezifinyezo, vula onhlamvukazi ube amagama, uphinde uqinisekise ukuthi ahambisana nenjongo yokukubeka ekuqaleni kwemilayezo.
Inhloso ukwazisa omunye ngokubeka lokhu ekuqaleni komlayezo. Qhathanisa amagama ahambelana no-F, Y no-I ezinketho.

e-h3e-job-d1.explanation: Person ngemuva kwesikhala liyibizo, ngakho isiphawulo reliable (ethembekile) esilichazayo silungile. reliably liyisandiso, ngakho alikwazi ukuchaza ibizo.
hints: Amagama amane asuka empandeni eyodwa, ngakho uhlobo lwegama lubaluleke kakhulu kunencazelo. Qala unqume ukuthi isikhala senza msebenzi muni emshweni.
Qinisekisa uhlobo lwegama elilandela ngokuqondile isikhala, bese ucabanga ukuthi iluphi uhlobo lwegama elichaza leli gama.

e-h3e-lit-1.explanation: Impendulo ilungile ithi foreshadowing (isixwayiso sangaphambili). Iyisu elikhomba kusengaphambili okuzokwenzeka kamuva. flashback ukubuyela esigabeni esidlule, ngakho akuyona inkomba yezinto ezizokwenzeka.
hints: Embuzweni wamagama emibhalo, khumbula incazelo bese uyifaka ekuhambeni kwezehlakalo. Leli su lisebenza kuphi enganekwaneni?
Bheka ukulandelana phakathi kwesikhathi lapho kushiwo ukuthi ibhuloho liyaphela amandla nalapho libhidlika.

e-h3e-lit-2.explanation: Impendulo ilungile ithi peace. Ijuba elimhlophe liwumfanekiso wendabuko wokuthula emibhalweni. danger ayihambisani nesigcawu sempi esiphelile.
hints: Embongweni isilwane noma into ingaba uphawu. Yixhumanise nesimo sesigcawu esivelayo.
Cabanga ukuthi abantu bafisa mkhulu muni ngemuva kwempi, bese ufuna igama elihambisana naleso simo.

e-h3e-lit-3.explanation: Impendulo ilungile ithi umbono omazi konke (omniscient). Kungenxa yokuthi kwaziwa imicabango yabalingiswa abaningi. Umbono limited ukhombisa umcabango womlingiswa oyedwa kuphela, ngakho awuhambisani nesibonelo esiveza imicabango yabantuababili.
hints: Embuzweni womqondo wombono, bheka ukuthi ngubani okhulumayo nokuthi umxoxi wazi imicabango yabantu abangaki.
Qinisekisa ukuthi isibonelo sichaza yini imicabango ka-Anna no-Tom bobabili, bese ukhetha umbono ohambisana nalokho.

e-h3e-lit-4.explanation: Impendulo ilungile ithi Kindness often comes back to those who give it. Ikhuluma ngesizathu nomphumela wendaba ngomcabango ojwayelekile ngempilo. The story takes place in a market incazelo yesikhungo nje, hhayi indikimba.
hints: Indikimba akuyona umcimbi noma isikhungo, kodwa umcabango ojwayelekile ngempilo indaba eyikhuluma.
Hlola ukuthi ubudlelwano phakathi kwesenzo senkwenyana nemiphumela yaso busuke buhlanganiswe emshweni owodwa, futhi ukuthi akuphikisani nendaba.

e-h3e-lit-5.explanation: Impendulo ilungile ithi protagonist (umlingiswa oyinhloko). Ungumlingiswa esikhungweni sendaba onenhloso futhi ohola izehlakalo. antagonist ngumlingiswa ophikisana nomlingiswa oyinhloko, ngakho indima iphambene.
hints: Amagama abalingiswa ahlukaniswa ngendima. Umlingiswa oyinhloko, ophikisanayo nomxoxi wendaba bahlukile.
Qhathanisa incazelo ethi ‘wants something and drives the action’ yombuzo nencazelo yegama lenketho ngayinye.

e-h3e-lit-d1.explanation: Iphethini ephinda ngokuvamile amasilabhasi anengcindezelo nangenayo yi-rhythm (meter). plot structure ukulandelana kwezehlakalo, ngakho ayihlangene nomsindo.
hints: Chaza incazelo yombuzo (stressed and unstressed syllables, regular pattern) ngamazwi akho emshweni owodwa, bese ukhetha inketho ehambisana nayo.
Uma amasilabhasi stressed no-unstressed eqhubeka ngokulandelana, kuzwakala kanjani lapho ubhekene nomsindo? Funa igama elibhekisela kuleso simo.

e-h3e-media-1.explanation: Impendulo ilungile ukuchaza isithombe kulabo abangasiboni. Umbhalo ongenisayo (alt text) uthi okuqukethwe kumafundi esikrini noma lapho isithombe singavuleki. Ukuvimbela ukukopisha indima yobunjiniyela obuhlukile.
hints: Hlaziya igama lelo gama. alt isifinyezo se-alternative (enye indlela).
Cabanga ukuthi lesi sici sisiza bani nasiphi isimo, bese ususa kuqala izinketho ezikude nenhloso.

e-h3e-media-2.explanation: Impendulo ilungile ithi The new park is the most beautiful place in town. ‘Okuhle kakhulu’ kuyisihlolo esihlukile komunye nomunye, ngakho kuwumbono. Inyanga yokuvulwa, indawo nenani lamapaki okudlala amaqiniso aqinisekisekayo.
hints: Iqiniso lingaqinisekiswa, kanti umbono uhlukile komunye nomunye. Cabangela ukuthi umusho ngamunye uyaqinisekiswa yini.
Bheka ukuthi ulwazi olungaqinisekiswa njengosuku, indawo nenani, nokuthi ukhona yini umusho wokuhlola.

e-h3e-media-3.explanation: Impendulo ilungile ukuthi kuthathwa ukuthi itiye liyimbangela yokuthuthuka. Ukuthi uthuthukile ngemuva kokuphuza itiye akusho ukuthi kungenxa yetiye. formal style uyisitayela nje, hhayi ubuthakathaka bokucabanga.
hints: Hlanganisa ngomugqa owodwa ukuthi lesi simemezelo siphuma kusiphi isizathu siye kusiphi isiphetho. Bese uzibuza ukuthi lesi sizathu sodwa sisisekela ngokwanele yini lesi siphetho. Qinisekisa nokuthi inketho ikhuluma ngokuxhumana kokucabanga, noma ngokuvelayo nje kombhalo.
Gxila ekutheni ixhumanisa kanjani ukuphuza itiye nokuthuthuka ukuze ifinyelele esiphethweni, bese ushiya izinketho ezikhuluma ngamagama noma isitayela.

e-h3e-media-4.explanation: Impendulo ilungile ithi Students gather with balloons at the annual school fair. Abafundi, ibhaluni nomcimbi wesikole konke kuyahambisana nokuqukethwe isithombe. Izinketho ezifana nesigijimi esiwela umugqa wokuqeda sisodwa zihluke ngokuphelele esithombeni.
hints: Umbhalo ongaphansi kwesithombe kumele uchaze abantu, indawo nezenzo ezibonakala ngempela esithombeni.
Qala ngokubhala abantu, indawo nezinto ezisendaweni ezivela embuzweni, bese uqhathanisa ukuthi inketho ngayinye ihlangana kangakanani nazo.

e-h3e-media-5.explanation: Impendulo ilungile ithi Track changes. Ikhombisa izinguquko ukuze iphakamise ukuhlaziywa ngaphandle kokususa umbhalo wangempela. Print preview isebenza ukubuka kuqala ukubukeka kokuphrinta kuphela, ngakho ayihlangene nezeluleko zokuhlela.
hints: Hlela izimo ozifunayo. Kufanele iphakamise ukuhlaziywa kodwa ingasusi umbhalo wangempela.
Hlola ukuthi inketho ngayinye ihlobene yini nokuhlela idokhumenti, futhi uma ihlobene, ukuthi ikhombisa yini izinguquko ngaphandle kokulahlekelwa umbhalo wangempela.

e-h3e-media-d1.explanation: echo chamber isho iqembu lapho umuntu ezwa kuphela imibono efana neyakhe, ngakho imicabango yakhe iqina. Ikamelo lokuxoxa elibuyisela umyalezo kabili libuyisela nje umsindo noma umbhalo, futhi alihlangene nokuthambekela kwemibono.
hints: echo chamber akuyona ikamelo langempela kodwa kuwumsebenzisomagama womfanekiso. Cabanga ukuthi ukuvuka kwephimbo kuhambisana nani online.
Cabanga ukuthi yini ebuya njalo njengomsindo wokuvuza, bese uhlukanisa izinketho ezikhuluma ngomsindo uqobo nezikhuluma ngemicabango yabantu.

e-h3e-world-1.explanation: Impendulo ilungile ulimi olusetshenziswa abantu abanezilimi zomdabu ezihlukene. Indima ye-Ingisi ekuxhumaneni kwamazwe ngamazwe isibonelo salokho. Ulimi lwomndeni owodwa alukwazi ukuba i-lingua franca.
hints: Ungethuki uma ubona isisho sesiLatini esingajwayelekile. Qala uqhathanise ukuthi inketho ngayinye ichaza kanjani ‘ngubani osebenzisa lolo limi’, bese ususa kuqala ezinesimo esinciphile kakhulu noma esingajwayelekile.
Qhathanisa inketho ngayinye ukuthi ngubani osebenzisa ulimi nokuthi unobudlelwano obunjani.

e-h3e-world-2.explanation: Impendulo ilungile ithi stereotype. Isho inkolelo elula ngokweqile mayelana neqembu lonke. dialect isho indlela yokukhuluma yesifunda, ngakho akuyona inkolelo ngabantu.
hints: Embuzweni wencazelo, khipha amagama abalulekile. oversimplified ne-whole group iyisihluthulelo.
Qala uhlukanise ukuthi igama lenketho ngayinye libhekisela emcabangweni mayelana neqembu, indlela yokukhuluma, umcimbi noma umndeni.

e-h3e-world-3.explanation: Impendulo ilungile ithi diversity. cultural diversity kusho ukuhlukahluka kwamasiko. division kusho ‘ukwahlukana, ukuhlukanisa’, ngakho kuphambene nencazelo ethi ‘siyahlala ndawonye’.
hints: Ngamagama anokubhaliwa okufanayo, qhathanisa izincazelo usebenzisa incazelo elandela isikhala njengesiqondiso.
Qhathanisa incazelo yokuthi abantu bezizinda ezihlukene bahlala ndawonye nencazelo yebizo elandela ngokwemvelo igama elithi cultural.

e-h3e-world-4.explanation: Impendulo ilungile ithi Their customs are different from ours, and I would like to learn why. Kuyisimo sokwamukela umehluko nokufisa ukufunda. Amagama anjengokuthi strange and backward adelela isiko labanye.
hints: Embuzweni wokuzwela amasiko, bheka ukuthi kuyahlulelwa isiko elinye yini, noma kuzanywa ukuliqonda.
Hlola ukuthi kukhona yini amagama anjengokuthi all, wrong, backward ahlanganisa wonke umuntu noma ahlukanisa phezulu naphansi.

e-h3e-world-5.explanation: Impendulo ilungile ithi authentic. Isho ‘eyiqiniso, ethembekile’. artificial isho into eyenziwe umuntu futhi engeyona eyiqiniso, ngakho iphambene.
hints: Shintsha isisho esiyinhloko sencazelo genuine ngamagama alula.
Cabanga ukuthi yini ephambene ne-‘not copied’, bese ususa kuqala inketho enencazelo ephambene.

e-h3e-world-d1.explanation: I-indigenous isho okwasendaweni, okungokwalelo zwe kusukela ekuqaleni. I-foreign isho okuvela kwelinye izwe, ngakho iyiphambene ngokuphelele.
hints: Funda incazelo bese ubamba umqondo oyinhloko, uphinde uyiqhathanise nencazelo yegama ngalinye.
Gxila engxenyeni ethi “the first people who lived in a region”. Funa igama elihambisana nale ncazelo phakathi kwalawo ahlobene nesimanje, isikhathi noma imvelaphi.

e-h3e-write-1.explanation: Impendulo elungile ithi makes. I-'make a case for' iyi-collocation ekhona esho 'ukwethula impikiswano evuna into', ngakho ifanelana kahle nesimo lapho i-report ikhipha impikiswano ngobufakazi. I-does iyisenzo esijwayelekile futhi ayihambisani ne-'a case for', ngakho ayilungile.
hints: Khumbula amapheya esenzo negama njenge-collocation, hhayi incazelo kuphela. Cabanga ngesenzo esisetshenziswa ne-a case.
Qhathanisa izenzo ezivame ukubhangqwa ne-case ngomqondo wokuthi umbiko 'wethula' impikiswano.

e-h3e-write-2.explanation: Impendulo elungile ithi Organized a school recycling campaign that collected 300 kilograms of paper. Iqala ngesenzo futhi ibonisa okwenziwe nemiphumela ngezinombolo. I-Helped with various things ... ayiveli ukuthi kwenziweini.
hints: I-resume ibonisa impumelelo ngokuqondile nangokufushane. Gwema amazwi angacacile.
Qhathanisa ukuthi ukukhetha ngakunye kuchaza umsebenzi othile yini, noma kumane kuyimibono yomuntu noma incazelo engacacile.

e-h3e-write-3.explanation: Impendulo elungile ithi Although the museum was crowded, we stayed for three hours. Kuyinto eqhathanisayo: kwakuminyene kodwa basala isikhathi eside, ngakho i-Although iyafanelana. I-so we left after a short time iphikisana neqiniso lokuthi basala isikhathi eside.
hints: Uma uhlanganisa imishwana emibili, qala ngokunquma ubudlelwano phakathi kwamaqiniso womabili (isizathu, ukuqhathanisa, isikhathi).
Cabanga ukuthi iqiniso lokuthi kwakuminyene neqiniso lokuthi basala amahora amathathu kuhambisana yini nokulindelekile noma kuphikisana.

e-h3e-write-4.explanation: Impendulo elungile ithi The students who joined the club met every Friday. Isihloko The students sinesenzo esiyinhloko met. Ukukhetha okuqala ngeBecause kuyisigatshana esincikile, ngakho ayiphelele ngoba ingasekho umphumela.
hints: Umusho ophelele unesihloko nesenzo esiyinhloko futhi umqondo wawo uyaphela. Ungadukiswa yizigatshana ze-relative, ze-conjunction noma i-ing phrase.
Kukhetho ngalunye, funa ukuthi ukhona yini isenzo esiyinhloko sesigatshana esiyinhloko (isenzo esinesikhathi). Hlukanisa ingxenye elandela i-who noma i-because.

e-h3e-write-5.explanation: Impendulo elungile ithi an opinion letter to the board. Uma inhloso iwukunxenxa, incwadi yombono ethula impikiswano ngobufakazi iyafaneleka. I-diary entry iyirekhodi lomuntu siqu, ngakho akuyona umbhalo wokunxenxa ibhodi lesikole.
hints: Inhloso yombhalo (ukunxenxa, ukwazisa, ukurekhoda) nomufundi kunquma uhlobo lombhalo.
Cabanga ukuthi umbhalo ucela muphi kumuphi, bese ufuna uhlobo lombhalo olusetshenziselwa leyo nhloso.

e-h3e-write-d1.explanation: Esigabeni se-editing, ufuna futhi ulungise amaphutha ohlelo lolimi, ukupela nezimpawu zokuhlukanisa embhalweni oqediwe. Ukuqoqa imibono kwenziwa esigabeni se-brainstorming (prewriting), ngakho kwehlukile ku-editing.
hints: Izigaba zokubhala zinomsindo ohleliwe. Khumbula ukuthi isigaba ngasinye senzani phakathi kokucabanga, uhlaka, ukubuyekeza nokuhlela, bese ukhetha incazelo efanele isigaba sokuhlela.
I-editing yisigaba esenziwa umbhalo usuphelele ngokuphelele. Hlukanisa ukuthi ukukhetha ngakunye kuyinto yangaphambi kokubhala noma ukucwenga umbhalo osuqediwe.

e-m2-comp-1.prompt: Khetha igama elifanele esikhaleni: My bag is ____ than yours.
hints: Izichasiso ezimfushane zisebenzisa -er/-est, ezinde zisebenzisa more/most. Emva kwento eqhathaniswayo sebenzisa than.
